description:
Starts watching a CNPJ. The first one is free; each extra slot is paid per 30 days, with no automatic renewal (the price is in `x-price-usd` and in `/api/pricing`).
Quota exceeded: **402 with `accepts[]`** (x402), or, with a credit token, a direct debit from the balance. Pay and repeat the same call with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (v2) or `X-PAYMENT` (v1); the slot goes to the global `direito` and the watch starts.

cnpj.description: CNPJ to watch, without punctuation: 14 digits or the alphanumeric one.

credito.description: Global prepaid credit token (cred_…), issued by POST /api/credito.
